items.title: Modernizing the Way Financial Records Are Retrieved
items.blurb: Designed and implemented a scalable search results workflow for financial correction notices, enabling front- and back-office operators to quickly locate, review, and manage transaction amendments while supporting future API integration.

items.title: Connecting a Bank Deposit Flow to Production APIs
items.blurb: Replaced mocked data with production APIs, refactored business logic, and resolved cross-functional misalignments to operationalize a mission-critical financial reconciliation workflow.

items.title: Delivering a Scalable Refund & Cancellation System Before the Backend Existed
items.blurb: Designing a state-driven cancellation architecture that enabled early delivery, reduced operational friction, and prepared the platform for future API integration.

items.title: Modernizing a High-Volume Bank Deposit Flow
items.blurb: Designed and implemented a multi-step bank deposit workflow within a large-scale government platform, enabling accurate end-of-day financial reconciliation for thousands of service agents—while navigating API gaps and cross-team dependencies.
